title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

visible.description: False for a document SOLIDWORKS loaded only because an open assembly uses it: it has no window of its own.

closed.description: The document as it was just before it closed.

discarded.description: True when unsaved changes were lost: its own, or those of a document it unloaded.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

visible.description: False for a document SOLIDWORKS loaded only because an open assembly uses it: it has no window of its own.

unloaded.description: For an assembly or a drawing: the documents it used that SOLIDWORKS unloaded with it, as they were just before. Empty otherwise.

still_used_by.description: The open documents (assemblies, drawings) that still use it: it lost its window but stays loaded for them, unsaved changes included. Empty when it was unloaded.
